freeze.label_inspection_before_freeze: Seven-base labels and run-01 output were already inspected; this is an exploratory correction, not confirmatory.
freeze.amendment_reason: Run-01 retained the source script threshold of 4 folds while protocol-v3 specified 5. Preserve run-01 unchanged; v4 changes only the serialized and applied minimum fold-win threshold to 5 of 7. Model, features, data, folds, baseline, and other metrics are unchanged.

objective: Fit the already-fixed six-base ridge model on an expanded seven-base panel including r29, and compare grouped held-out-base prediction to the matched-configuration training-fold mean.

claims.statement: Descriptive grouped leave-one-base-out MAE and fold wins of fixed ridge versus matched-configuration baseline on verified finite-interval midpoints.
No causal factor-base ranking, exact dreg theorem, affine FFD/LFD, solver cost, or ECDLP recovery claim.

data.target: midpoint of certified finite dreg interval; positive-dimensional rows excluded and counted separately

model.preprocessing: numeric standardization fit inside training fold; categorical one-hot

validation.grouped_rows: all family/m/target rows from a base remain together
validation.baseline: training-fold mean within exact family/m/target configuration

positive_control.reason: The target is a descriptive regression; no detector or lead screen is asserted.

negative_control.reason: Labels were inspected before this exploratory fit; no null hypothesis or significance claim.

aa.reason: Deterministic fixed model; no timing claim.

decision_rule: Exploratory lead flag only if aggregate ridge MAE is lower than baseline and ridge wins at least 5 of 7 held-out bases. No statistical significance or causal interpretation.
inadmissible: exact degree claim from interval midpoint
hyperparameter or feature changes after inspecting the new base labels
source_control: All source rows and labels were collected before protocol freeze; protocol freezes only this deterministic exploratory training and its comparison.
